name: flight.k
model:
package examples {

annotation doc : String

class Airplane {
  var engines:Seq[Engine]
  val controller:FlightController
  val leftWing:Wing
  val rightWing:Wing
  val landing:Bool
  val takeoff:Bool
  var speed:Real
  var flaps:Real

  req landing || landing

  req takeoff || takeoff

  req LandingFlaps: landing => (flaps > 15)

  req TakeoffFlaps: takeoff => flaps <= 15

  req TakeoffSpeed: takeoff => (flaps = 10) && (speed > 63) && (speed < 74)

  req LandingSpeed: landing => ((flaps = 16) && (speed > 40) && (speed < 54))
}

class Wing

class Engine

class Actuator {
  var value:Real

  fun read

}

class FlightController {
  val act1:Actuator
  val act2:Actuator

  req ActuatorAvg: (act1.value + act2.value) / 2E0 <= 3.14E-2
}


}

(declare-sort Engine) (declare-const mk-Engine Engine)
(declare-datatypes () ((Actuator (mk-Actuator (value Real)))))

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
